text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Victory in the Takarazuka Kinen.
But Seiun 
Sky's newfound confidence that she can
win as long as she thinks things through
would be short-lived.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The piercing gazes of her rivals drill 
into her back.
Knowing they will only grow 
stronger using defeat as fuel, Seiun Sky 
falters for a moment.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"Everything's just gotten so boring now." 
Seiun Sky lets the words slip out. Was it 
a moment of weakness, or did she have an 
ulterior motive...?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Following King Halo's nomination, Seiun 
Sky decides on the Tenno Sho (Autumn) for 
his next race.
It marks the beginning of a 
summer filled with lingering anxiety――
